description: This file defines Lua bindings for player-related data in the Unvanquished game, including getter functions for player attributes and initialization code for Lua integration.

classes.name: Player
classes.description: A placeholder class used for Lua binding purposes.

methods.name: Getteam
methods.description: Lua getter for player's team name.

methods.name: Getclass
methods.description: Lua getter for player's class name.

methods.name: Getweapon
methods.description: Lua getter for player's weapon name.

methods.name: Gethp
methods.description: Lua getter for player's health points.

methods.name: Getammo
methods.description: Lua getter for player's ammo count.

methods.name: Getclips

methods.name: Getscore
